zh-CN.title: Niko 主题焕新
items: 头像框与聊天气泡统一调整为蓬松白与暖棕配色
气泡纹理改为低对比猫爪图案
Niko 现在固定在气泡上沿原地奔跑，不再环绕四边

en.title: A refreshed Niko theme
items: Avatar frames and chat bubbles now share a fluffy white and warm brown palette
Bubble textures now use subtle paw-print patterns
Niko now runs in place along the top edge instead of circling the bubble
